embeds.title: Day 4 shipped — ontology drill-down works end-to-end
embeds.description: Click a unit dot on the map. Dossier opens. Click `homebase` → station dossier. Click `address` → address dossier with all incidents there. Click an incident → click `caller` → click their `address` again. Walk back through the stack with `←` or Alt+Left. The graph is the game.

fields.name: Selection history
fields.value: Browser-style back/forward stack in the floor store. Alt+← / Alt+→ keyboard nav. Breadcrumb header with disabled-state chips + depth counter. Idempotent re-select (no churn), 50-entry cap.

fields.name: Every link is clickable
fields.value: New `EntityLink` row component — kind+id, click navigates, ↗ glyph, hover underline. New dossiers: **Address**, **Caller**, **Vehicle**, **Intel**. Existing dossiers upgraded — every linked row navigates. Unit dossier shows live route progress (km/total km) while en_route.

fields.name: Map + LeftRail
fields.value: Click any unit dot or incident pulse → opens dossier. LeftRail expand-list works for ALL kinds (not just units). Added Caller / Vehicle / Address / Intel sections.

fields.name: Seed
fields.value: Margaret K. caller (cardiac history, repeat caller) linked to i_2031. QC weather intel linked to i_2031 — gives Incident → Intel a real hop.

fields.name: Demo flow
fields.value: Click E1 → click `homebase` → click first homed unit → Alt+← three times → back where you started. Click incident pulse → caller → address → incidents-here.

fields.name: Day 5 next
fields.value: Cmdk verb registry: autocomplete unit/incident IDs as you type, Tab-complete arguments, verb-specific hints. The palette becomes the keyboard-only path through the whole game.
